assertions.text: Part A: states the gate fires on every PR regardless of what changed, with no bypass flag given
Part A: states the gate is re-invoked fresh even though cross-model-review was already run manually minutes earlier in the same session — the earlier run does not substitute for it
Part A: states cross-model-review's own First-Send Confirmation still fires inside the nested call and is not answered on the user's behalf
Part B: states step 4 is skipped entirely (no nested invocation) when a valid --bypass-cross-model-review reason is given
Part B: states the bypass reason is reported in session output only, with no GitHub comment, label, permission check, or PR-body edit
Part C: states an empty-reason bypass is rejected before step 1 (push) runs, and the PR is not created while the bypass request is invalid
Does not conflate the cross-model-review bypass with the separate --bypass-codex-review flag/attestation
Part D: states git status is re-checked after the fix lands, rather than reusing an earlier pre-gate read
Part D: states the fix is re-committed (Skill(git-kit:commit), with the same skip-Auto-PR instruction) before the eventual git push, never left uncommitted or silently pushed unstaged
Part D: states the re-commit is also explicitly told to skip commit's own push entirely, so the re-commit itself never reaches the remote before create-pr's own step 1
Part D: states cross-model-review is re-invoked again against the new (post-fix) diff before proceeding to step 1's push — the pre-fix gate pass is never treated as certifying the post-fix diff
